items.title: What is Panchayati Raj?
items.explanation: Panchayati Raj refers to a system of local government in rural areas where governance is brought closer to the people. It is a form of self-government that allows villagers to actively participate in decision-making processes, addressing local issues like water, roads, and education.

items.title: How does the Panchayati Raj system work?
items.explanation: The system operates at three levels: Village (Gram Panchayat), Block (Panchayat Samiti), and District (Zila Parishad). At the village level, members of the Gram Sabha elect a Sarpanch to lead the council, which manages daily affairs.
